item.question: In what ways does MMAudio achieve state-of-the-art performance in video-to-audio synthesis?
item.answer: MMAudio achieves state-of-the-art performance by employing a novel multimodal joint training framework and a flow matching objective. This results in high-quality, semantically aligned, and synchronized audio generation with low inference time and efficient parameter usage.
